cohort_total_n_excerpt: To further explore this hypothesis, we measured serum selenium in 212 cases and 233 controls participating in a multicenter, population-based case-control study that included comparable numbers of U.S. black and white men aged 40-79 years.
reason: The abstract analyzes prostate cancer generally and does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal endpoint. The 212 cases and 233 controls yield 445 participants.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Serum selenium was inversely associated with risk of prostate cancer (comparing highest to lowest quartiles, OR = 0.71, 95% CI 0.39-1.28; p for trend = 0.11), with similar patterns seen in both blacks and whites.
estimate_classifications.reason: The selenium estimate is for prostate cancer generally.
